overviewHtml:
"Did my deploy make it slower?" often gets answered by looking at a chart. This prompt runs a proper before and after comparison and stops early when nothing regressed.

What you get

  • An investigation window anchored on the latest deployment event
  • Before and after comparison of P95 response time, error rate and throughput
  • Regression thresholds that decide whether to dig deeper
  • Trace investigation and a rollback or hotfix recommendation
getStartedHtml:
You need a Dynatrace environment, the Dynatrace for AI skills and a tool that reaches it (dtctl or the Dynatrace MCP server).

  1. Copy the prompt into your AI chat or prompt folder
  2. Confirm the service and when the regression began
  3. Review the comparison and the recommendation
